The record's file pin is of the reviewed working-tree bytes. The layer is not yet committed at review time, so no commit is named here; the commit is the act that fixes these bytes.
This is a publication-content review, not a mathematical review. It does not verify any statement in the layer, and catalog checks are structural only.
review.decision_reason: Admitted for the same reason as v0: the layer is original project prose and organization, cites external literature by identifier and link without incorporating third-party expressive content beyond short attributed abstract excerpts, adds no mathematical claim, and changes no existing pin, catalog entry, claim registry entry or growth obligation.
